newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil states' deficit hits record levels - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil states' deficit hits record levels - paper.

text.p: The deficit accumulated by Brazil's states is hitting record levels according to Central Bank figures which show a deficit of 4 billion reais ($3.88 billion) in the January to July period, a newsaper said.
This deficit figure, which excludes interest rate costs, amounts to 0.7 percent of gross domestic product, the highest level since 1983, O Globo newspaper said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
